keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «충분한 잠은 뇌가 잘 일하도록 도와서 중요하다(주제)» 와 «좋은 잠은 뇌를 건강하게 지키는 가장 좋은 방법 중 하나다(결론)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the topic (enough sleep is important because it helps the brain work well) and the conclusion (good sleep is one of the best ways to keep the brain healthy). The green sentences are the answers.

qs.q: What often happens when people do not get enough sleep?
qs.qko: 사람들이 잠을 충분히 자지 못하면 흔히 어떤 일이 생기나요?
opts: Their brains clean out more waste
evs: When people do not get enough sleep, they often have trouble paying attention.
It stores important information as memories, so you can remember it later.
Experts say that children and teenagers need more sleep than adults.
Going to bed at the same time every night and putting away phones before bed can help.
why: 잠을 충분히 자지 못하면 집중하기 어려워지는 경우가 많다고 했어요.
When people do not get enough sleep, they often have trouble paying attention.

qs.q: In «They may also feel grumpy,» what does «grumpy» mean?
qs.qko: «They may also feel grumpy» 에서 «grumpy» 는 무슨 뜻인가요?
evs: They may also feel grumpy and make more mistakes.
While you sleep, your brain sorts through what you learned during the day.
Experts say that children and teenagers need more sleep than adults.
Good sleep is not lazy; it is one of the best ways to keep your brain healthy.
why: 잠이 부족한 사람이 실수도 더 많이 한다는 문장과 함께 나와요. 좋은 기분이 아니라 «짜증이 난» 상태라는 뜻이에요.
It appears together with making more mistakes when people lack sleep. So «grumpy» means in a bad mood, not a good one.

qs.q: How does sleep help you remember what you learned?
qs.qko: 잠은 배운 것을 기억하는 데 어떻게 도움이 되나요?
opts: The brain sorts what you learned and stores it as memories
The brain throws away everything you learned
Phones store your memories at night
evs: While you sleep, your brain sorts through what you learned during the day.
When people do not get enough sleep, they often have trouble paying attention.
It stores important information as memories, so you can remember it later.
Going to bed at the same time every night and putting away phones before bed can help.
why: 자는 동안 뇌는 낮에 배운 것을 정리하고, 중요한 정보를 기억으로 저장해요. 두 문장을 이어야 알 수 있어요.
While you sleep, the brain sorts what you learned and stores important information as memories. You need both sentences.

write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «어떤 조건 + 그때 할 수 있는 일» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write a condition and what we can do then in English.
write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «If» 뒤에 «누가 + 무엇을 하는지» 를 넣어 조건을 분명하게 써 보세요. (예: If we sleep early)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «If», write who + what they do to make the condition clear. (e.g. If we sleep early)
write.src: “If <u>we sleep well every night</u>, we can <u>pay attention in class</u>.”
